description: This Java source file defines the LinkShareViewHolder class, which manages the display logic for shared link items in the Android app's sharing interface. It handles binding share data to UI components, setting icons and labels based on share type, visibility of UI elements, and interaction responses such as opening menus or copying links.

classes.name: LinkShareViewHolder
classes.description: A view holder class for managing UI display and interactions of shared links within the sharing list in the Android application.

methods.name: LinkShareViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view holder with the provided view or binding, setting up branding.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an OCShare object and listener to the UI components, setting texts, icons, colors, and click listeners based on the share type and properties.

methods.name: setPermissionName
methods.description: Sets the permission label in the UI based on share details and visibility logic.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to UI elements based on the provided color code.
